dedupe_keys.name: liquefaction mitigation of silty sands with micp

description: Liquefaction Mitigation of Silty Sands with MICP is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brina Montoya, North Carolina State University (ncsu.edu). Liquefiable soils require remediation to reduce the consequences of liquefaction. Methods used for improving sands can become restricted when applied to silty sands. These restrictions include lower permeability, environmental impacts, and higher costs. Therefore investigating the application of a new and more natural soil improvement method which can overcome these restrictions is necessary. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-5dtg-m375. Keywords: Liquefaction- MICP-Sands- Silty Sands. Published 2020-08-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
